subject: Pioneer Health - MAP and deployment decision workshop
messages:
From: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@pioneerhealth.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Villa <marco.villa@pioneerhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff + decision timeline (deployment mode + region)

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership is aligned to move forward but they want a compact MAP that makes the deployment-mode and region decision explicit (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, and US vs EU). Two priorities driving this: data residency for PHI workloads and predictable latency for triage flows.

Can you propose a short mutual action plan with evaluation milestones (functional runbook, latency tests, security checklist), a recommended assessment timeline, and what evidence you’ll provide for SOC2 / data handling? We’re aiming to finalize mode + region by 2027-01-10.

Also, Marco from infra will join the technical workshop. Vendor finance will need an early look at indicative pricing for Dedicated capacity if that’s the recommended route.

—Aisha
Aisha Rana, VP Product
Pioneer Health

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@pioneerhealth.ai>
Cc: Marco Villa <marco.villa@pioneerhealth.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + decision timeline (deployment mode + region)

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clarity on the decision window. I put together a one-page Mutual Action Plan and attached a MAP workbook that breaks the assessment into four milestones:

- Week 0–1: Discovery & constraints (data residency, PII/PHI scoping, traffic profile)
- Week 2: Functional eval (throughput, latency on sample flows) — hosted + dedicated variants
- Week 3: Security/compliance evidence review + penetration test snapshot (private deployment checklist if needed)
- Week 4: Decision workshop + signoff (recommendation and next steps)

Deliverables we will provide: test harness (load scripts), latency reports, SOC2 evidence bundle excerpt, and a preliminary SOW. For Dedicated we’ll include indicative reserved capacity pricing and an autoscale/burst plan. For Private (VPC/on‑prem) we’ll list packaging and estimated lift.

I’m copying Karthik from Solutions — he’ll scope the capacity/latency experiments and pricing options. Laura from PM will run the decision workshop.

If Jan 10 is the target, we should start discovery this week. Proposed next steps: 1) confirm the list of sample APIs and traffic profiles, 2) calendar a 60‑minute technical kickoff (bring procurement), 3) I’ll share MAP_v1 and the evidence bundle.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Attachments: Pioneer_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf (summary)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@pioneerhealth.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Villa <marco.villa@pioneerhealth.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + decision timeline (deployment mode + region)

Aisha / team —

Quick technical note to help shape the lab tests: please include a representative set of endpoints (3–5) that cover your triage NLP path — short dialogs (~64 tokens), and a higher throughput embedding/analytics batch (up to 4096 tokens for embedding jobs). Key data points we’ll need from you:

- Expected peak qps for triage (per region)
- Percent of traffic that must remain in-region (PHI scope)
- Retention constraints for logs/llm cache (if any)

If PHI needs to remain in-region and >80% of traffic is in EU/US, that pushes us to Dedicated or Private depending on procurement speed and network topology. Hosted can be acceptable for many customers with VPC peering and regional reservations — we’ll show measurement comparisons in the MAP.

I’ll prepare a small test harness and a pricing sheet for Dedicated reserve tiers so procurement has something to react to.

-Karthik
Director of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@pioneerhealth.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Villa <marco.villa@pioneerhealth.ai>, Procurement <procurement@pioneerhealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + decision timeline (deployment mode + region)

Thanks — good checklist. Answers inline:

- Peak qps (triage NLP): US east 120 qps, US west 30 qps, EU 75 qps (expected peaks).
- PHI in-region: yes, all triage session metadata must remain in-region; raw transcripts can be routed to central analytics after de‑identification.
- Retention: logs for 90 days, KV cache not persisted beyond 24 hours.

We’re also exploring an air‑gapped on‑prem appliance for one of our hospital partners; can you indicate high-level feasibility and a rough lift estimate in the MAP? Procurement would like an indicative procurement path and timeline for Dedicated vs Private.

We can do a technical kickoff on Monday 2026-12-21 at 10am PT. Procurement will need the Dedicated pricing sheet before the meeting.

—Aisha

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@pioneerhealth.ai>, Marco Villa <marco.villa@pioneerhealth.ai>, Procurement <procurement@pioneerhealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + decision timeline (deployment mode + region)

Great — thanks for the numbers, that helps a lot. Attached is a first MAP workbook (Pioneer_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW template (SOW_Redwood_v1.docx) with three options summarized: Hosted (regional reservations + VPC peering), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools in region with SLA), and Private (VPC/on‑prem appliance). Highlights:

- Based on the qps and PHI constraints, our initial recommendation is a two‑track approach: Hosted for non‑PHI analytics and a Dedicated US/EU lane for triage flows (to ensure in‑region residency and predictable latency).
- For the hospital partner that needs air‑gapped deployment, Private (on‑prem) is feasible but incurs a multi‑week integration and higher engineering uplift; we included a 6–8 week lift estimate in the SOW.
- Included SOC2 evidence snippets and a scoped pen test window (we can coordinate a test window during week 3 of the MAP).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the kickoff slot (Mon 2026‑12‑21 10am PT).
2) Procurement: we’ll send the Dedicated pricing sheet before EOD Friday (shown in the MAP tab labeled "Dedicated_Prices").
3) Marco/infra: please attach any firewall/VPC contacts we should loop in so we can pre‑seed peering steps.

If that all looks good, I’ll lock the MAP and calendar the workshop.

Cheers,
Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Attachments: Pioneer_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_Redwood_v1.docx
